definitions.full: H6274. Othniel עָתְנִיאֵל proper name, masculine son of Kenaz, a hero in Israel , Γοθονιηλ , Josh 15:17 ; Judg 1:13 ; 3:9 , 11 ; 1Chr 4:13 (twice in verse); name of family 27:15 .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 6273 and 410 ; force of God ;

occurrences.englishText: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.
When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
